lesson: DD 7/22 brake on weak-alpha cokurtosis strategy destroys more value than it protects. SR dropped 58% (0.645->0.272) while MDD only improved 19% (50.9%->41.3%). The 7% DD_START threshold is too sensitive — it triggers on normal market pullbacks and reduces exposure prematurely, killing compounding. When the parent strategy already has MDD>50% and SR<0.7, DD overlay cannot rescue it. Ref: Dittmar (2002) cokurtosis pricing shows the factor is priced but weak in Korean equities; Hwang & Satchell (1999) higher moment estimation requires long estimation windows that reduce timeliness. The R10_Cokurtosis bottom-10% gate adds marginal value over D01_IdioVol alone. DD calibration lesson: DD_START should be >= 2x the strategy's normal drawdown volatility (here ~15%), suggesting DD_START >= 12-15% for this alpha level.
